questions.text: Please specify the target charge level for the car (e.g., 80% or a specific energy level in kWh).
What is the exact time you need the car charged by tomorrow?
Are you planning to be away at any specific time tomorrow? If so, please provide the start and end times for the away period.
Do you want to adjust the indoor temperature for any specific time tomorrow? If so, please provide the start and end times and the desired temperature range (e.g., 21-23 C).

explanation: I need more details to plan the charging of your car for tomorrow.
